'''Hitpoints''' (also known as "health" or "HP") represent a player's health. If they reach zero, the player will [[Death|die]]. Hitpoints is the only skill for which players start with any experience initially - with 1,154 [[experience]] points, placing them at exactly level 10 on [[Tutorial Island]].
